name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 8, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Bill Record, member of the community
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to Don and Becky Hein, owners of Little Cakes Cupcake Kitchen, declaring Wednesday, May 9, 2012, "Little Cakes Cupcake Kitchen Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ended March 31, 2012 (CC)
C4.
Conflict of Interest Code Biennial Review (CC/SA/BSD)
C5.
Application for Cabaret License - Hyatt Place Vista (2645 S. Melrose Dr.) (CC)
C6.
Application for Cabaret License - Mother Earth Brew Co. (206 Main Street) (CC)
C7.
2012 Justice Assistance Grant (CC)
C8.
2012-2013 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Annual Action Plan and Revised 2011-2012 Annual Action Plan (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the 2012-2013 Annual Action Plan, authorizing submittal of the Plan to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development and authorizing the City Manager to approve and execute all documents related to the implementation of said Plan; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the revised 2011-2012 CDBG Annual Action Plan. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fiscal Year 2011/12 Third Quarter Financial Report (CC/BSD/CDC/SA)
1.
Receive and file the report; and
2.
Adopt the following:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the FY 2011/12 Operating Program Budget;
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the FY 2011/12 Capital Improvement Program Budget;
c.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2012- , amending the FY 2011/12 Capital Improvement Program Budget;
d.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , amending the FY 2011/12 Capital Improvement Program Budget; and
e.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Citywide Classification and Compensation Index.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
